text.Supply Depot:
How to Play ==
At any time during your turn, discard up to two cards, and gain 2 Trade or 2 Combat for every card discarded. If you have another Star Empire card in play, you may draw a card. 
 Strategy ==
Supply Depot is one of the best cards to buy if your deck is not (yet) well-scrapped, in the early game or mid-game. Discarding a Scout or Viper for 2 Trade can make it possible to buy more expensive cards, but you can also discard for Combat if you need to take out an opponents base. It is also a good idea if you plan to scrap your deck with cards that can only scrap in your discard pile: with this base, you can discard two cards, gain some Trade or Combat, and then scrap the cards. Drawing a card as an ally ability is also good. It is usually not the best card to buy in late game, because there are fewer cards to discard, but also because this base is more easily taken out as its defense is not as strong as some other expensive bases.
